scope: Native functional ROM/media replays, compiled MC68000 buffer/glyph tests and separate Release builds. Latency, throughput and complete peak memory are not accepted by these results.
waitSampleScope: Samples at Desktop Exec.Wait; excludes unsampled loader/IO/drawing transients and largest blocks. Probe veneers and the 4096-byte event trace are retained until reset and included in the stable baseline.

module.lifetime: Home and GUI code are DOS system residents until reset; one copy per identity

sourceScope: Desktop and replay sources match their snapshots. The ROM audit isolates the console overlay; the provider audit isolates two methods from its frozen baseline. The provider build verifies those modifier blocks against the live development file, which contains other development outside this profile.
remaining: Safe Save/Save As with source-change/collision decisions
Recoverable temporary/backup replacement on actual writable DOS media under short writes, close/rename failure, full/read-only disks and interruption
Files reload and byte-exact reopen plus host persistence
Directory/startup/paint latency, memory high-water/largest blocks and sustained/100-cycle stress
Child launch/return, shipping HDF admission and workspace/update persistence
